weeks.content:
Yellow and red make orange
Mix paints with a brush

Blue and yellow make green
Paint a green tree

Draw my head, hands and legs
Add my eyes and smile

Draw big people and small people
Name who is who

Print with real leaves
See the lines on the leaf

Mould an orange and a banana
Paint them when dry

Cut along a straight line with scissors
Paste my cut strips

Drag paint with a string
Make wavy designs

Decorate a paper face
Add eyes, nose and mouth

Walk and see everyone's art
Clap for each artist
